69 Activity Can

Parametric and physics-based circle simulation that represents the data of the user's activity. The amount and type of circles are data-driven. Filling the can goal can be set by a parameter. And when the goal is reached, circles fill the can and other extra particles stay outside. Physics connected to phone's motion sensors so the animation can be affected by phone movements.
